task.description:
REWORK ITERATION 1 (targeted fixture fix). TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR FAILed on ONE dimension: test/letflow/service_catalog_test.exs and test/letflow/engine_pin_resolver_catalog_test.exs both explicitly set Sandbox.mode(Letflow.Repo, :auto) for the global service_catalog table (real committed writes, no rollback -- needed for multi-process on_exit teardown), but cleanup_entry!/1 in BOTH files deletes only from Entry (service_catalog), never from Version (service_catalog_versions) -- permanently leaking an archive row into the shared test DB on every single invocation. TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR confirmed this empirically (5 passed tests left 2 new permanently-committed rows) and already cleaned up the leaked rows it found/caused via a one-off Repo.delete_all -- you do not need to clean the DB, only fix the test code.

Fix: extend cleanup_entry!/1 in BOTH files to also delete matching service_catalog_versions rows (by service_id, since that's the archive table's natural foreign reference) in the same on_exit callback, before or alongside the Entry deletion. Do not touch anything else -- narrow fix only. AC coverage (a/b/e checks: every AC has a runnable test, no TODOs, no hardcoded secrets) already PASSED and does not need rework.

After fixing, run the two affected test files TWICE IN A ROW in the same session yourself (mix test test/letflow/service_catalog_test.exs test/letflow/engine_pin_resolver_catalog_test.exs, then run it again immediately) and quote real output confirming no unique-constraint collision on the second run and that service_catalog_versions is empty of req373-owned rows after both runs (query it directly to confirm, don't just trust the test's own exit code). Complete the handoff with PASS/FAIL, commit and push (explicit filenames, never -A) before ending your turn. next_action: 'Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR for re-gate'.
acceptance_criteria: cleanup_entry!/1 in both files deletes matching service_catalog_versions rows
running the two test files twice in a row in the same session produces zero unique-constraint collisions
service_catalog_versions is empty of req373-owned rows after both runs, confirmed by direct query
